prompt: Night in a 1920s American city, a 16:9 picture filling the frame edge to edge. A 24mm lens clamped low on a speeding long black sedan looks back along its flank. Filling the upper half of the frame, a clean-shaven man of about seventy, creased and pouched, in a dark fedora and overcoat, rides the running board, one arm hooked through the window, a drum-fed submachine gun held straight up in his outer hand, clear of his face. His mouth is open mid-word, three-quarter to us. An orange-red neon tube out of frame paints his cheek and lips; cold blue bulbs rim his hat. The polished door mirrors shop lights as long streaks over wet cobbles. Shadows fall to true black. Thanks.
